seo.title: Dermatitis in Barbers: How to Protect Your Team's Hands
seo.description: Wet work, disinfectants and constant hand washing can damage barbers' skin. What HSE advises, employer duties, and a five-minute audit for your shop.

media.anchor: # Barbers' Hands: The Skin Problem That Builds Slowly and Costs Quietly

media.anchor: In a barbershop, the obvious culprits are wet work, cleaning and disinfecting tools, and some products used on clients.

media.anchor: None of HSE's advice for the sector is complicated, and most of it costs very little.
media.alt: HSE-inspired three-step workplace skin care diagram: avoid unnecessary exposure, protect with gloves and proper drying and moisturising, and check for early signs of dermatitis
